name: Alameda Porcini-Spiced Ahi Tuna
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced seared ahi tuna dusted with umami mushroom powder (zero rubbery mushroom chunks!) is a textbook Crohn's-friendly protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the seared porcini-dusted ahi tuna slices Only — strictly skip the black sesame brittle (seed shrapnel), pickled lotus root, and yuzu-wasabi mayonnaise (citrus extract).
